enabled.description: Enable or disable the mailnag daemon.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the mailnag process.

enable_notifications.description: Enable or disable desktop notifications (e.g., via libnotify).

enable_sounds.description: Enable or disable sound notifications when new mail arrives.

sound_file.description: Path to the sound file played for new mail notifications.

check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between mail server polling.

max_accounts.description: Maximum number of accounts to list in the summary notification popup.

accounts.description: List of mail accounts to monitor for new messages.

name.description: Unique name for the account (used as section identifier).

hostname.description: Mail server hostname or IP address.

use_starttls.description: Use STARTTLS to upgrade a plain connection to encrypted.

username.description: Username or email address used for login.

folder.description: Mail folder to monitor for new messages.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this specific account.

icon.description: Optional custom icon path to show in notifications for this account (e.g., a brand logo).
